newsitem.title: ROMANIA: BUCHAREST BOURSE KEEPS OVERALL MARKET UP.
newsitem.headline: BUCHAREST BOURSE KEEPS OVERALL MARKET UP.

text.p: A bull run on the bourse and higher prices for over-the-counter blue chips helped Romania's equity market higher on Wednesday, with an independent index showing it 3.2 percent up on the previous session.
The unofficial VAB market index, compiled by VANGUARD brokerage house, rose 28.4 points from Tuesday to 918.1 points. It was 14.8 percent up on the week.
Trading on the equities markets is expected to remain heavy for the rest of the week and the market index likely to climb further.
Heavy local and foreign buying of the bourse's first-tier stocks sent the prices of all four high-caps up and boosted traded volumes.
Fertiliser maker Azomures rose 120 lei to close at 2,100 lei and Oltchim chemical plant gained 60 lei to 1,460.
The tier's two pharmaceuticals companies -- Antibiotice and Terapia -- also drifted higher, rising by 100 and 300 lei to 4,100 and 3,650 respectively.

Brokers said trading had also been more active in the second tier, with Policolor dye maker getting more than 403 million lei in turnover and scoring a special trade, which pushed its price 100 lei up to 2,450.
On the RASDAQ, Romania's OTC market patterned on the U.S. NASDAQ, buyers also focused on several high-caps -- including cement makers and oil refineries -- whose prices shot up.
These heavyweights are expected to attract investors' attention throughout the week.
Casial cement maker, an OTC star for several weeks, remained at centre-stage, closing 200 lei firmer at 1,300.
The VAB index for the OTC market jogged up 2.9 percent from the previous session to 2,728.75 points.
Volume on the RASDAQ on Tuesday rose to 3.02 million shares from 2.3 million at the previous session, with turnover up to 14.13 billion lei from 8.42 billion.
The RASDAQ, which lists 2,740 stocks, traded 458 companies on Wednesday.
The VAB index is displayed on VANGUARD.
